datasets.title: HapMap 3.2.1 whole genome sequencing data
datasets.description: Alignments to the maize B73 reference genome v3, generated with `bwa mem`, with BAM index files from `samtools index`. If you need FASTQ files, the [SamToFastq tool in Picard](https://broadinstitute.github.io/picard/command-line-overview.html#SamToFastq) converts BAM to FASTQ.
datasets.citation: [Construction of the third generation *Zea mays* haplotype map. *GigaScience*, 2017. doi:10.1093/gigascience/gix134](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/29300887)
datasets.notice: The file gateway no longer links to these BAM files. Email [qisun@cornell.edu](mailto:qisun@cornell.edu) for access.

datasets.title: Maize 282 association panel
datasets.description: Whole genome sequencing data in both FASTQ and BAM formats. Genotype calls derived from these data are on the [Genotypes](/genotypes#hapmap) page.
datasets.citation: [Construction of the third generation *Zea mays* haplotype map. *GigaScience*, 2017. doi:10.1093/gigascience/gix134](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/29300887)

datasets.title: CML247
datasets.description: Five PCR-free libraries sequenced for CML247 at 130X in total: a 500 bp library (~65X, 2×300 bp, 10 MiSeq lanes), an 800 bp library (~17X, 2×150 bp, 1 HiSeq 2500 lane), and 3–5 kb, 5–7 kb, and 8–10 kb mate-pair libraries (each ~17X, 2×150 bp, 1 HiSeq 2500 lane).
datasets.notice: The file gateway does not link to these reads. Email [qisun@cornell.edu](mailto:qisun@cornell.edu) for access.
